summary: Iteration 142 - Mobility P0 Gaps Testing Complete. All 25 backend tests PASSED. Frontend verification confirmed all 7 payment methods (including credit_card and cash), favorites/recent cards, and multilingual support. MongoDB collections verified: mobility_trips(9), mobility_bookings(40), mobility_routes(12), mobility_favorites(8), mobility_vehicles(3), mobility_drivers(1).

backend_api_tests.payment_options_includes_cash: PASS - GET /api/mobility-platform/payment-options includes cash with label 'Cash'
backend_api_tests.payment_options_all_seven_methods: PASS - Returns all 7 methods: wallet, nfc, qr, apple_pay, google_pay, credit_card, cash

backend_api_tests.create_work_favorite: PASS - POST with kind=work creates work favorite

backend_api_tests.mobility_bookings_collection_written: PASS - Bookings written to mobility_bookings collection
backend_api_tests.mobility_favorites_collection_written: PASS - Favorites written to mobility_favorites collection
